overall_assessment: Reviewed all 20 sampled courses (14 suspects, 6 random controls) and all 18 attendance appendix items: 18 correct moves, 0 wrong moves. The widened attendance moves are sound and no moved sentences are duplicated in their sampled source sections, but an unflagged control still leaves mandatory attendance in teaching_methods; other high-severity defects include a whole legacy plan without sections, lost or misfiled prerequisites, incomplete coursework-block separation, discarded exam-language rules, and administrative content retained in sections. Short/duplicate flags often reveal placeholders, whereas repeated substantive teaching, MAT-1002 requirements and 1 oral exam. are false alarms; controls confirm broader defects, and PHS/FHS-specific fixes cannot be assessed from this UiT packet.

findings.evidence: Independent thesis writing. The student will be given supervision during the search for literature and during the writing process.
findings.description: No sections are emitted although the full plan contains substantive course content, objectives, teaching methods and assessment. The page-heading list contains only navigation/contact headings.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/institution_config.R UiT HTML selectors and R/extract_sections.R page_sections() text fallback do not recover the legacy fields whose headings run directly after prose.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the UiT legacy field reader to recognize these inline field labels, including Course contents, Objective of the course, Teaching methods and Assessment methods; invoke the fallback when HTML yields no substantive sections.

findings.description: Twelve sampled suspects emit sections consisting solely of contact notices, dummy info, or Se fagbeskrivelse med pensum; the master-thesis control also emits a bare reading-list pointer. These are absent/elsewhere sections, not substantive outcomes, methods, assessment or readings. Duplicate/short/empty flags identify real placeholder failures here, but 1 oral exam. is valid assessment. The source already repeats these notices, so the duplicate flags do not establish extractor-created duplication.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .placeholder_phrases omits Contact the faculty., Contact the department/faculty., Kontakt fakultetet, info, Se fagbeskrivelse med pensum and Se våre nettsider for pensum:.
findings.suggested_fix: Add anchored whole-placeholder patterns for these observed variants, including repeated placeholder-only paragraphs; remove them before keeping rows and strip placeholder paragraphs from otherwise substantive sections.

findings.description: Administrative admission/study-right text is repeatedly retained as course content, including in five of six random controls. MUS courses contain only admission/contact text in this section; the master-thesis control also retains topic-approval deadlines and study-place rules. Such text is outside the seven canonical sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: UiT Om emnet/About the course blocks mix subject matter and administration; .clean_sections() applies admission cleanup only to prerequisites.
findings.suggested_fix: Apply sentence-level admission/study-right and administrative-deadline cleanup to UiT course_content; first preserve and route any stated prior-course or subject-knowledge requirement to prerequisites, and keep genuine subject-matter text.

findings.evidence: Recommended prerequisites: Basic knowledge at University Bachelor level in physiology, biochemistry and cell biology.
findings.description: Two random controls lose explicit recommended prior knowledge entirely. FIN-1025 specifies FIN-1014 or equivalent skills inside Opptakskrav; MBI-3016 states bachelor-level physiology, biochemistry and cell biology inside Admission requirements. Neither has a prerequisites row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R drops Opptakskrav and leaves Admission requirements unmapped; sectionize() discards their text before inline prerequisite recovery, which only examines course_content.
findings.suggested_fix: Before discarding admission blocks, extract paragraphs introduced by Anbefalte forkunnskaper or Recommended prerequisites into prerequisites and then remove the remaining admission boilerplate.

findings.evidence: Før studentene kan begynne på 4. avdeling, må de ha bestått 3. avdeling.
findings.description: Five law-course assessments contain prior-course/progression requirements rather than assessment design, including the requirement to pass JUR-0500. The master-thesis random control leaves its completed-third-division prerequisite in course_content. These belong in prerequisites; preserve a mixed admission/prior-course sentence whole as the specification requires.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_prerequisites() only recognizes explicit prerequisite labels in course_content and never inspects assessment for unlabelled prior-course requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Add deterministic UiT progression/prior-course sentence rules for bestått 3. avdeling and JUR-0500, examine assessment and course_content, and move complete matching sentences to prerequisites before admission cleanup.

findings.evidence: For å få godkjent JUR-3005 obligatorisk utplassering i praksis kreves a. godkjent deltakelse på praksisforberedende undervisning b. godkjent gjennomført praksisperiode og c. godkjent praksisrapport.
findings.description: Four fourth-division law courses move the first compulsory oral presentation but leave the second explicit exam gate, JUR-3005 and its approval conditions, in assessment. The full plan places both under the same coursework lead-in. This is a required prior placement approval for these law exams, not the graded assessment of the audited course.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .split_inline_coursework() ends a coursework block at intervening link-label paragraphs such as Studieplan/Eksamensreglement and fails to resume it for the later JUR-3005 item.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the coursework block active across its rule-link paragraphs until the explicit Eksamen består av boundary; include the later JUR-3005 requirement and its approval details, while excluding navigation-only link labels.

findings.evidence: Deltakelse på innføringskurset er et vilkår for å levere masteroppgave til bedømmelse.
findings.description: The random master-thesis course leaves Obligatoriske forelesninger. and the introductory-course attendance gate, including its exemption rule, in teaching_methods and emits no coursework_requirements. This is an explicit approval gate for submitting the thesis. No sampled moved attendance sentence was duplicated in its source section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .attendance_sentence_regex misses the short Obligatoriske forelesninger wording; .gate_sentence_regex does not recognize the er et vilkår for å levere ... til bedømmelse construction.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize these anchored compulsory-lecture and vilkår for å levere ... til bedømmelse forms; move the gate and its attendance-exemption sentence together to coursework_requirements, retaining the course-description sentences in teaching_methods.

findings.evidence:
Tillatte hjelpemidler til eksamen:
Rottmanns tabeller
Godkjente statistiske tabeller
Fire A4-ark (8 sider) med egne notater
Godkjent kalkulator.
findings.description: The reading list ends with permitted exam aids. The leak->assessment flag is a real boundary error: the aids heading and list describe assessment design and belong in assessment. MAT-1001, lecture/exercise hours, the written test and compulsory exercises are legitimate repeated content despite boilerplate flags.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The UiT reader does not expose this embedded aids label as a page heading, although R/section_heading_map.R already recognizes Tillatte hjelpemidler.
findings.suggested_fix: Split anchored Tillatte hjelpemidler til eksamen labels inside reading_list and route the heading and following aids list to assessment; alternatively expose the embedded label as a reader subheading.

findings.evidence: Studenten kan svare på eksamen på et skandinavisk språk eller på finsk.
findings.description: Every sampled plan has its combined instruction/examination-language block discarded. This loses exam-language design required by course_plan_spec.md; FIN-1025 and FYS-8804 explicitly specify allowed answer languages, while other plans give the shared teaching/exam language. This is not a loss of learning-outcome subgroups: the substantive sampled outcomes retain their groups.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R explicitly maps Undervisnings- og eksamensspråk and Language of instruction and examination to .drop.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle combined language blocks before .drop: move explicit exam-language sentences to assessment and retain a shared bare language value with an Eksamensspråk/Language of examination label; discard teaching-only language metadata.

findings.evidence: Students who failed the exam must re-sit both the written and the oral examination.
findings.description: Assessment repeatedly retains resit rights, postponed-exam arrangements, registration deadlines and examiner arrangements instead of only assessment design. Four random controls retain resit rules; the master-thesis control additionally keeps examiner composition and deliberation procedures. Law-course suspects show the same inline resit leakage, so this extends beyond pre-pass suspects.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .section_noise$uit only strips a provisional-date notice and table-cell noise; .drop handles real resit headings but not labels embedded in prose or inline resit sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Add UiT sentence-level resit/postponement, registration and examiner-arrangement cleanup for the observed Norwegian/English variants; recognize inline Kontinuasjonseksamen labels and remove their logistics blocks while preserving exam components, duration, grading and assessment criteria.

findings.evidence: Emnet evalueres muntlig eller skriftlig minimum en gang hvert tredje år.
findings.description: Two random controls retain course-quality evaluation notices in teaching_methods. FIN-1025 also retains its Kvalitetssikring av emnet label and programme-board evaluation procedure. These describe administration of course evaluation rather than how students learn.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .evaluation_part_regex only recognizes Emneevaluering as a standalone heading, not Kvalitetssikring av emnet or inline Emnet evalueres sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend teaching-method cleanup to the anchored Kvalitetssikring av emnet block and the observed course-evaluation sentences; retain student assessment and feedback activities.
